claim: This evidence covers the installed Product 1B package performing only system.status and core.services reads against one disposable local OPNsense 26.1.6 VM.
limitations: Disposable local VM only; no production firewall or Internet-facing deployment was used.
This is not evidence for public DNS, ACME, HAProxy, mutations, backups, restore, Windows, or the agentic benchmark.
No raw firewall response, API credential, certificate, or temporary package is retained.
